why: Found by I117 while building, before any measured run (Q67: a test is never dropped from its CI job; amended to name the mode it was written for). P6 says that without the opt-ins every output is as before, so the protocols before I115 name none of I115's opt-ins (run_unbound, bind, preflight_go). It globbed every spec/M6/lib/i1*_run.json except i115_run.json, so it also judged later keys: I117's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i117_run.json, its base plus go.ops) carries I115's opt-ins by construction and would fail it, although no earlier protocol changed. The amended check also skips the protocols of I115 and later keys (an iteration field I115 or above), as I115 amended I112's test_p1. Every earlier protocol is still checked, and the claim is unchanged.
